cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28.0)

# A8 icon images generated by tools/build_lvgl_icons.py from svg/.
# The Device info support QR code (tools/build_support_qr.py) is one more A8 image.
add_library(furnace_hmi_icons STATIC generated/hmi_icons.c generated/support_qr.c)
add_library(furnace_hmi::icons ALIAS furnace_hmi_icons)

target_include_directories(furnace_hmi_icons
  PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/include
)
target_link_libraries(furnace_hmi_icons PUBLIC lvgl::lvgl)
target_compile_features(furnace_hmi_icons PUBLIC c_std_17)

if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(furnace_hmi_icons PRIVATE /W4 /WX /permissive-)
else()
  target_compile_options(furnace_hmi_icons PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
endif()
